objective: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.

description: I have some choice cuts of meat that I want to send to a friend.  Her name is Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar.  Will you deliver the meat for me?
The fastest way to Orgrimmar is on a wind rider.  Take the meats to the Crossroads wind rider master, Devrak, and speak with him about transport to Orgrimmar.
progress: You need to get somewhere fast? Then you're talking to the right orc!
completion: You have to get this meat to Orgrimmar? That is no problem. For a small fee, my wind rider can take you there.
